summary: Round 2: literature-grounded verdict on Route A (Simpson-faithful consistent-prime IS5 box-backward). Mined the actual Simpson 1994 chunks. Finding: Simpson does NOT provide a portable prime-theory symmetric box-backward for IS5. His §3.3 birelational prime-theory canonical model is by his own words an OUTLINE (chunk 0221) that defers the symmetric extensions to Fischer Servi [24] as 'straightforward' (chunks 0245-0246). His RIGOROUS, intuitionistically-acceptable IS5 completeness (Chapters 7-8) abandons prime theories for LABELLED 'T-prime bounded contexts' whose accessibility is a graph completed to be symmetric (T-Comp, Lemma 8.2.5) with box-backward via a bounded canonical model lemma over labelled membership (Lemma 8.2.6) and a bounded prime lemma using decidability of the consequence relation by case analysis/contraposition (chunks 0839-0852, 0907-0908) — i.e. Route B technology, which Marin 2021 explicitly extends (Marin chunk 0004). The one classical step (decidability by case analysis) is NOT a CSLib blocker (Lean has Classical.em); the real blocker is structural: prime (non-maximal) theories lack negation-completeness, so the symmetric back-clause becomes a bound jointly unsatisfiable with refuting the box subject over a fixed head — provably tripping the mechanized guardrail cs5_symmetric_tail_box_gap (CS5.lean:712). Verified independently (via the B-axiom ◇□q→q) AND against the landed source. Escape requires a simultaneous prime-pair Lindenbaum with a stable primeness invariant — the OPEN task-512 Phase 8-10 problem that Simpson himself sidestepped by switching to labels.
portability_verdict: NOT faithfully portable. Route A rests on a prime-theory symmetric box-backward that does not exist in Simpson; it is a research gamble on the open pair-primeness-stability problem, not a transcription. Route B (Marin fully-labelled) is the faithful port of Simpson's OWN rigorous IS5 method.

guardrail_check.cs5Incest_forces_symm: NOT tripped — irrelevant; Simpson routes symmetry algebraically (two-sided R), not via the le-mediated incestuality condition.
guardrail_check.cs5TwoSidedR_iff_cs5Tail: NOT tripped — confirmatory; it states Simpson's two-sided R IS the symmetric tail over quasi-prime worlds. Harmless because Simpson's symmetry is algebraic (cs5Tail_symm), not informational.
guardrail_check.cs5_symmetric_tail_box_gap: TRIPPED — this is the wall. Simpson's dia-clause bound Y ⊆ diaInv H equals boxInv Y ⊆ H (cs5_boxInv_subset_iff), landing the bounded Lindenbaum inside this lemma's hypotheses; it provably cannot keep p out over a fixed head. Simpson's rigorous route evades it ONLY by leaving prime theories for labels.
guardrail_check.atom_sum_result: NOT a new escape — decidability-by-case-analysis is a meta-level Classical.em, not a lowering of the atom-sum forcing obligation.
